notes: Feeds W8-19i (dialogs::settings::pages::shortcuts). Reflection over the internal ShortcutsSettingsPage and SettingsPageBuilder of PhotoReview.dll; see tools/oracle-cs/Commands/W8-19i.cs for the case kinds and output fields.
id_base is SettingsDialog.PageIdBase(4) = 5000 (Shortcuts is the fifth navigation entry). English default localizer. Run against the C# baseline d92d6aae (the HEAD page has two more Action rows).

find_problems texts: property name -> typed text. The expected sets are the ones of the C# tests AnAliasSpelling_CountsAsTheSameKey and FindProblems_FlagsEmptyMandatory_AndInvalidNames_ButNotEmptyOptional plus the cases below.

cases.name: empty mandatory, invalid name and refused key are problems; empty optional and padded valid are not
alias spellings count as the same key
two empty optional boxes are not a conflict
two optional boxes with the same key are a conflict
an optional key equal to a mandatory one marks both
three boxes with one key are all marked
